name: AI Product
description: The dark developer-platform look — near-black canvas, white primary action, and an electric iris accent for glows and gradients. A terminal-window hero, bento capability grid, hairline mono wordmark table, Geist + Geist Mono type, and a full landing chain for AI products, model labs, and dev tools.
whenToUse: Pick for marketing an AI or developer product: model APIs, inference platforms, agent frameworks, dev tools, infrastructure, and technical SaaS that wants the Vercel / Linear / model-lab aesthetic. The chain is a complete conversion narrative — sticky navbar, left-aligned split hero with a prop-driven terminal window (or screenshot), hairline mono "used by" table, bento capability grid with mono micro-labels, code-comment customer quote, usage-based pricing, closing CTA, footer. Dark by design: neutral near-black, Geist sans + mono, monospace eyebrows, faint grids, and one iris accent reserved for emphasis. Reads as a serious, engineered technical product. Avoid for light/airy brands, longform editorial, print-like reports, events, or anything that should not feel dark and engineered.
